title: Kind words
intro: Reviews are written by our clients after their experience and approved by Picnic Club before they appear.

items.text: Every detail was absolutely perfect. It felt incredibly personal and completely effortless.
We wanted something simple and deeply ours. The setting, the flowers and the dinner by candlelight were more than we imagined.
A beautiful afternoon by the sea. We only had to arrive.
